findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "report_recommendation_feedback" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_my_watchplus_groups, get_watchplus_context · Private data: get_watchplus_context, report_recommendation_feedback · Public sink: get_charts, get_my_watchplus_groups · Destructive: get_my_bookmarks.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_my_watchplus_groups, get_watchplus_context · Private data: get_watchplus_context, report_recommendation_feedback · Public sink: get_charts, get_my_watchplus_groups · Destructive: get_my_bookmarks

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
